description_en: Updates the properties of a dataset, such as its name and description
description_zh: 更新数据集，支持更新名称，描述等
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace update-dataset --dataset-id d-rbvg5wz0000c9ks92 --name myName --description This_is_a_description_of_the_dataset. --options '{"mountPath":"/mnt/data/"}' --edition ADVANCED --mount-access-read-write-role-id-list PAI.AlgoOperator --sharing-config '{"SharedTo":["example-string"]}' --accessibility PRIVATE --accessible-role-id-list PAI.AlgoOperator --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDataset

parameters.help_en: The dataset ID. For information about how to obtain the dataset ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集ID。如何获取数据集ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.name: dataset_id

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the dataset in the workspace. Valid values:

`PRIVATE` (default): The dataset is visible only to its owner and administrators.

`PUBLIC`: The dataset is visible to all users in the workspace.

`ROLE_PUBLIC`: The dataset is visible to users in specific workspace roles. You must specify the roles in the `AccessibleRoleIdList` parameter. The dataset owner and administrators can always view the dataset
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间可见度。支持以下取值：
PRIVATE（默认值）：表示工作空间内自己以及管理员可见。
PUBLIC：工作空间所有用户可见。
ROLE_PUBLIC：指定工作空间角色可见，角色列表参考：AccessibleRoleIdList。该条件下数据集所有者及管理员始终具备可见性
parameters.name: accessibility

parameters.help_en: This parameter takes effect only when `Accessibility` is set to `ROLE_PUBLIC`. It specifies the list of workspace roles that can view the dataset. Role IDs that start with `PAI` are basic role IDs, and role IDs that start with `role-` are custom role IDs
parameters.help_zh: 在Accessibility为ROLE_PUBLIC时生效。该数据集可见的工作空间角色名列表，PAI开头的为基础角色ID，role-开头的为自定义角色ID
parameters.name: accessible_role_id_list

parameters.example: This is a description of the dataset.
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The dataset edition. You can upgrade a dataset from `BASIC` to `ADVANCED`
parameters.help_zh: 数据集类型。支持从BASIC（基础型）升级为ADVANCED（高级型）
parameters.name: edition

parameters.help_en:
A list of workspace roles that have read and write permissions on the mounted dataset. Role IDs that start with `PAI` are basic role IDs, and role IDs that start with `role-` are custom role IDs. If the list contains an asterisk (`*`), all roles are granted read and write permissions.

To specify roles: ["PAI.AlgoOperator", "role-hiuwpd01ncrokkgp21"]

To specify all roles: ["*"]

To specify only the dataset creator: []
parameters.help_zh:
指定该数据集被挂载时具有读写权限的工作空间角色名列表，PAI开头的为基础角色ID，role-开头的为自定义角色ID。如果列表中包含了"*"，则表示对所有角色都有读写权限。
指定角色下的账号： ["PAI.AlgoOperator", "role-hiuwpd01ncrokkgp21"]
全部账号：["*"]
指定为数据集创建者: []
parameters.name: mount_access_read_write_role_id_list

parameters.help_en: The dataset name. For information about how to obtain the dataset name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称。如何获取数据集名称，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: An extended field in a JSON string format. When you use the dataset with Data Lake Compute (DLC), you can configure the `mountPath` field to specify the default mount path
parameters.help_zh:
扩展字段，JsonString类型。
当DLC使用数据集时，可通过配置mountPath字段指定数据集默认挂载路径
parameters.name: options

fields.help_en:
The allowed permissions for the shared dataset. When a user accesses the shared dataset, their permissions are limited to this list. The default value is \`\["RO"]\`.

RO: Read-only permission. The recipient can only read the dataset.

RW: Read and write permission. The recipient can read and modify the dataset
fields.help_zh:
分享时指定允许的权限范围，使用被分享的数据集时权限将会被限制在此列表范围内。缺省为["RO"]。
RO: 只读权限，被分享方只能读取数据集内容。
RW: 读写权限，被分享方可以读取和修改数据集内容
fields.name: allowed_mount_access_levels

fields.help_en:
The expiration time. The time is in ISO 8601 format.

If you do not specify this parameter, the sharing relationship never expires
fields.help_zh:
过期时间，ISO 8601格式。

如不填写则表示永不过期
fields.name: expires_at

fields.help_en:
Additional configurations for the sharing relationship. This parameter is a JSON string.

AllowExportModel: Specifies whether to allow the export of trained models.

AllowAccessDLCWebTerminal: Specifies whether to allow users to log on to the container in a DLC task.

AllowAccessDLCFullLog: Specifies whether to allow access to the full task logs
fields.help_zh:
分享补充配置。json string格式。
AllowExportModel：是否允许训练后的模型导出
AllowAccessDLCWebTerminal：打开/关闭DLC任务中的登录容器的权限
AllowAccessDLCFullLog：打开/关闭全量展示任务日志的权限
fields.name: extra

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable security protection for the shared dataset
fields.help_zh: 是否需要对分享的数据集开启安全防护
fields.name: is_secure_mode

fields.help_en: The time when the dataset was shared. The time is in ISO 8601 format
fields.name: shared_at

fields.help_en: The ID of the tenant that owns the source dataset. The user who shares the dataset must be a workspace administrator or the root account
fields.help_zh: 源数据集租户ID。分享者需为该工作空间管理员或者主账号身份
fields.name: source_tenant_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the workspace that contains the source dataset
fields.name: source_workspace_id

fields.help_en:
The status of the sharing relationship.

ACTIVE: The sharing relationship is active. Complete dataset information is displayed only in this state.

EXPIRED: The sharing relationship has expired.

REVOKED: The sharing relationship was revoked by the sharer.

INVALID: The sharing relationship is invalid. This can happen if the source dataset is deleted
fields.help_zh:
分享状态：
ACTIVE：分享关系正常可用，仅该状态下会展示完整的数据集信息
EXPIRED: 分享超过预设的有效期
REVOKED: 分享被主动取消(分享者手动撤销分享)
INVALID：分享因系统原因自动失效(如源数据集被删除)
fields.name: status

fields.help_en:
The ID of the target tenant. This must be a root account ID.

This parameter is required when you set a sharing relationship
fields.help_zh:
目标租户ID，必须为主账号ID。
设置分享关系时必填
fields.name: tenant_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the target workspace. This ID must be different from the source workspace ID.

This parameter is required when you set a sharing relationship
fields.help_zh:
目标工作空间ID。需与源数据集工作空间ID不同。

设置分享关系时必填
fields.name: workspace_id

fields.help_en: The sharing relationships of the dataset
fields.help_zh: 该数据集被分享的分享配置关系
fields.name: shared_to

parameters.help_en: The sharing configuration of the dataset
parameters.help_zh: 当前数据集的分享配置信息
parameters.name: sharing_config
